label: input u at orig positions 4-6 in a sequence starting with 2, after an o/a
explanation: Very sparse feature (~0.004% of steps), almost entirely in the original phase at t=4-6 (t=3-7 holds ~99% of mass). Never fires in the copy phase, and only weakly on a handful of delimiter steps. Two strong requirements: the input token is u (85% of mass, 24x lift) and the first original token is the digit 2 (96% of mass, 28x lift). Activation is strongest when o or a came right before (prev_tok o is 14x lift); the top examples look like 2 n a o u and 2 n o o u. Weak activations also show up on other tokens (v, w, t, g, x, b) in 2-initial sequences at the same positions. It does not fire on u at t<=2 or t>=8, or on u in sequences that do not start with 2. Precision is limited: many cases of 2 ... u at t=4-6 stay silent, so the feature seems to need a specific prefix state that the simple variables do not capture. Of the simpler predicates, u & first_tok=2 & t in 3-7 alone gets mass recall 0.81 but precision 0.09.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 37 cues. Raise it: orig0=2 (+5.28), prev_tok=o (+2.70), orig1=n (+2.40), prev_tok=a (+1.76), orig2=a (+1.60), phase=0 & in_tok=u (+1.53). Lower it: orig_idx=-1 (-2.22), prev3_tok=- (-2.00), prev3_tok=2 (-1.17), prev2_tok=2 (-1.07).
